{{Quote|''This'' directive is, unfortunately, quite clear.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Voss Parck]]|<ref name="Choices of One">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref>}}
'''Directive 417''', also known as '''Directive Four-Seventeen''', was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] directive, invoked in the event that any [[Moff/Legends|Imperial Governor]] was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] by forces (or suspected forces) of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], then that governor's successor was required to immediately transmit a call for aid to any nearby Imperial forces. The Directive also required any forces receiving the signal to immediately converge on the site of the assassination, even if it meant abandoning their current operations.

The Directive was put into effect approximately six months after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and two months before the [[Battle of the Poln system]]. [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]], did not learn about it until she was on [[Poln Major]], and cynically regarded it as [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] latest, unnecessary attempt to ensure that he would be given the first chance at capturing or killing any Rebel forces.

[[Nuso Esva]], a [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] active in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], hoped to use Directive 417 to draw [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] forces into a trap over Poln Major. He attempted to arrange the assassination of Governor [[Bidor Ferrouz]] at a time when [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] - a known Rebel, instantly recognizable by his [[Anakin Skywalker's first lightsaber|lightsaber]] - was nearby. Although Jade, Skywalker, and the renegade [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]] unit "The [[Hand of Judgment]]" prevented Ferrouz's assassination, his senior security officer, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Kauf Ularno|Ularno]], issued the Directive anyway. The nearest available Imperial forces were Captain Thrawn's, under the command of Captain [[Voss Parck]], who, though he was already engaged with Esva's forces, conceded that he had no choice but to break off and [[Hyperspace/Legends|jump]] to the [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]] immediately.

However, Thrawn was able to turn the ensuing [[Battle of the Poln system|battle]] into a resounding victory, not least because the Hand of Judgment's actions had delayed the signal for a few crucial hours, during which time significant elements of Esva's forces on Poln Major were re-tasked and their ships eventually destroyed.
